Text: We hired Svetlana remotely to do HTML and CSS work and provide ancillary design services in 2010 and 2011. She combines three things you really need in a remote contractor: first, competence -- she knows what she is doing and does a good job; second, communication -- she's quick to respond to emails and easy to discuss plans, change orders and issues with; third, reliability -- she does what she says she will do, gets things done on time, and doesn't overpromise. It's been a pleasure working with her and I hope to do so again some time.

Beverly is a very insightful and thorough user experience analyst. She has helped me improve both information architecture for marketing sites and user interactions in web apps. She gets the "big picture" quickly, and uses this understanding to spot weaknesses effectively and provide great ideas for improvements. She also brings an understanding of project management, to which end she will prioritize problems to fix and areas to split-test, and help her clients create a road-map toward a more effective user experience. She communicates effectively and is easy to work with. Unconditionally recommended.
